purpose: Preserve the evaluated four-lens Engineering Council as a reproducible baseline while later rosters vary size, grouping, lineage, and prompt composition.

slots.decision_function: Dependency direction, information hiding, volatility seams, ports and adapters, and testable policy.
Domain language, workflows, lifecycle, invariants, consistency boundaries, and ownership.
Simplicity, deep modules, convention, reversibility, refactoring sequence, and anti-ceremony.
Security, reliability, data integrity, deployment, observability, recovery, and measured performance.

independence_claim.lineage: The four functional lenses were designed to counterbalance one another, but shared authoring context means lineage independence is not established.
independence_claim.runtime: Generation one used separate first-pass advisor calls from a shared factual brief; exact runtime evidence remains bound to its provenance receipt.
independence_claim.outcome: A private one-sample-per-cell evaluation observed useful differences but cannot establish independent error distributions or optimal composition.

known_limits: The roster covers engineering decisions only and must not be reused as a product, research, or design council without domain-specific validation.
Four slots are a historical fact, not a demonstrated optimum or minimum.
Functional role labels do not prove intellectual, model-family, or outcome independence.
The source-bound representative library was created after this generation and was not part of its runtime prompts.
